thread:
Ruth (CS): FYI Riverbend Labs (acct: RB-900) shows a ~92% fall in generation+embed calls starting 2026-05-02. Renewal is 2026-07-03. New CTO (Dmitri) started 5/1 and procurement flagged a short evaluation with CloudPrompt. We should triage before procurement completes bench.
Ben (AM): Thanks Ruth. Can you paste the daily snapshot and any auth/billing flags? I'll reach out to Dmitri.
Ruth (CS): Quick query snapshot:
```sql
-- RB-900 daily usage
SELECT date, sum(calls) as calls, sum(tokens) as tokens FROM api_usage WHERE client_id='RB-900' AND date >= '2026-04-25' GROUP BY date ORDER BY date;
-- sample rows: 2026-05-01 calls=9,800 tokens=1.6M; 2026-05-02 calls=740 tokens=110k; 2026-05-03 calls=620 tokens=95k
```
Ruth (CS): No 401/403 spikes. ops-bot flagged a sudden drop and a small retry bump.
ops-bot: Alert created: RB-900 anomaly (calls down 92%, retry rate +1.4%) 2026-05-02T10:12Z.
Sofia (Solutions): I'll scan logs for regional routing/latency regressions and check if any model alias changes were applied. Also can check per-key throttles.
procurement-bot: Procurement note detected: "CloudPrompt pilot requested" 2026-05-02 by Riverbend procurement.
Ben (AM): Outreach plan: quick, non-salesy note to Dmitri asking if this is an intentional pause and offering a short bench on their real prompts. Ruth, can you draft?
Ruth (CS): Draft sent: "Hi Dmitri 

We noticed a big reduction in traffic from Riverbend beginning 5/2. If you're running a side-by-side with CloudPrompt, happy to run a 3-query perf and token-cost comparison on your exact prompts and extend your trial two weeks so it's apples-to-apples. Also we can help validate any SAML/SSO or key rotation steps. No strings attached. 



-Ruth"
Keiko (Onboarding): I can offer a 30-min session focused on prompt parity for their highest-volume flows and a short checklist for SAML + dedupe of service accounts. Thu/Fri morning PT open.
Sofia (Solutions): Early infra check: no global routing or model alias rollouts targeting RB-900. I see a small uptick in client-side backoff attempts around 2026-05-02T10:11Z which could mean they paused ingestion jobs. Will post trace in ~10m.
Ben (AM): Ruth, can you include a low-effort offer: 2-week trial extension + a gratis perf bench. If Dmitri confirms the side-by-side, gather 3 representative prompts.
Ruth (CS): Sent outreach. Also noted they opened a ticket with billing last week about invoice formatting; billing status shows "past due" but not suspended. Might be a procurement tactic.
Sofia (Solutions): Found traces: several requests from RB-900 were retried by client at lower frequency after 10:10Z with exponentially increasing backoff. No 5xx. Likely the client throttled themselves or paused schedules.
Keiko (Onboarding): I'll prepare a short deck for a prompt parity session and include sample SDK snippets for jitter/backoff and recommended batch sizes for embeddings (20->8).
Ben (AM): Dmitri replied: they're evaluating CloudPrompt and want a quick apples-to-apples comparison. He asked if we can show token-costs plus a mini-benchmark on two real prompts. He also asked about SAML readiness for their security team.
Ruth (CS): Plan of record: 1) Keiko runs prompt parity session (Thu morning PT). 2) Sofia runs perf harness on two prompts once Ben obtains them (24h turnaround). 3) Offer 2-week trial extension + optional canary (dedicated) capacity for load tests. 4) Ben to loop security for SAML checklist.
Sofia (Solutions): Can do bench + cost estimate after they share prompts. I recommend including 95p latency and per-query token count with cost model variants.
Ben (AM): Owners: Ben (exec/procurement), Ruth (log monitoring + outreach), Sofia (bench), Keiko (enablement). Adding note to CS ticket CS-8122 and scheduling renewal watch on 2026-06-20.
Ruth (CS): Will monitor for any further drops and post back if usage resumes or if Dmitri requests the extension.
Keiko (Onboarding): Tentative invite booked Thu 9:30am PT. Will include SAML checklist.
Ben (AM): Thanks team. Goal: deliver bench + cost numbers within 48h of getting prompts so Riverbend can decide before procurement completes evaluation. :hourglass:
